4:romance, for she was a daughter of the pioneers — those ill - fed and ill - clothed people who, in spite of their shortcomings, intellectual, moral, and physical, have been the most forceful race in history. _ thirdly. _ this story vindicates the higher education of women. your grandmother, dear peggy, was a bachelor of arts. now it is maintained in some quarters that women become bachelors so as to avoid having children. but your grandmother had four sons, every one of whom she sent through harvard college. _ finally. _ this story will demonstrate conclusively that college - bred women should not marry young men who earn less than three hundred dollars a year. when you marry, dear peggy, insist that your husband shall earn at least a dollar a day. this precept will bar out the european nobility, but will put a premium on american nobility. signed and sealed this 1st day of november, in the year of our lord 1908, at annapolis, anne arundel county, maryland. angelo hall.
